Jharkhand : Nisha Bhagat Case men aaropi Ajay Tirkey aur Jyotsna ke ghar pahunchi CBI
Aadivasi netri nisha kumari bhagat ki sandigdh maut ki janch ab CBI ne apne hathon men le li hai. ejensi ne FIR darj kar kes ko RC0482026S0007 nanbar aavantit kiya hai. janch shuru karte hi sibiaaee ki tim mukhy aaropi ajay tirki aur jyotsana kerketta ke ghar pahunchi aur sakshyon ki partal ki.
